Traders are now estimating an 85% likelihood of a quarter-point increase in the upcoming meeting, with further rate hikes expected in December.

Investment demand remained strong in top consumer China, while silver and platinum also saw gains.

This move aligns with the directive from the Securities Appellate Tribunal regarding an orderly settlement process.
